product_metadata.title: Clara Clark 100-Percent Egyptian Cotton Flannel 4-Piece Bed Sheet Set, Luxurious Soft Hypoallergenic, King, Charcoal Gray
features: King size 4pc set, flat sheet 102"x105" (259x266cm), fitted sheet 78"x80" (198x203cm), 2 pillowcases 20"x40" (50x101cm)
Lightweight comfy 160-gram 100% Egyptian cotton flannel comes pre-washed and lightly brushed for softness.
Velvet flannel fitted sheet comes with an 18-inch corner depth and includes an elastic on all sides, Both the flat sheets and pillowcases are finished with an elegant 4-inch hem.
Easy to care for, this sheet set can be machine washed in warm with like colors on the gentle cycle, then tumble dried on low - or hung out on the clothesline to dry on a warm sunny day.

Silky soft, and comfortable and luxurious bed sheets you can ever find. Works best for any room in your house, Bedroom, guest room, kids room, RV, vacation home and makes a perfect gift for your loved one.
